Research origin

Motivation, not derivation.

MQM began within Benjamin Walker Mayes’s Unified Dynamics research. Tetrahedral adjacency, face closure, packet-local transport and branch structure motivated preserving three-dimensional relationships long enough to test them. Those concepts do not derive a qubit implementation or validate a code, circuit or device. Every MQM claim must stand on its stated QEC mathematics, replayable checks and, where applicable, independent hardware evidence. Physical promotion remains 0.
